subject: ventures/pergola-bid-calculator
professional: a senior estimator at a deck and outdoor-living contractor who prices pergolas and patio covers; first checks: post count and bay spacing vs. the beam span, whether overhangs/tails are in the beam and rafter takeoff, and that margin is on price not cost

evidence.correctness: Independent Python re-implementation from the README method (python3 /tmp/claude-0/audit-pergola-bid-calculator/recompute.py) reproduces all four preset rows on vs-a-flat-45-per-square-foot-special.html to the cent: 10x10 cost $2,813.18 / price $3,750.90 / 37.5% at $45/sf; 12x16 slats $4,840.90 / $6,454.54 / 44.0%; 12x16 louvered $8,210.93 / $10,947.91 / 5.0%; 16x20 poly $11,792.29 / $15,723.06 / 18.1%. 10x10 also hand-worked: 13.9 h x $41.60 + $1,518 materials + $350 soft = $2,446.24 x 1.15 = $2,813.18. Margin is cost/(1-m) (share of price), correct. Capped at 3 because the post-count rule lets a bay exceed the entered spacing by up to 2x (postsAlong(15,8) = 2, a 15-ft clear beam span at '8 ft spacing').
evidence.completeness: README features checked end to end in code: footprint, posts (floor+1, min 2), attached ledger dropping house row, rafters, beams, shade kits, height kits, loaded wage/overhead/margin, walk-away price, proposed-price check, copy summary (formatBidSummary), share link (share.mjs), proposal with deposit/signature (proposal.mjs), usage tally with DNT/GPC skip (usage.mjs:21). All present and wired in index.html. No TODOs or stubs found.
evidence.verification: node --test *.test.mjs: 131 pass, 0 fail (also plain `node --test` as README says: 131 pass). 5 mutants via quality_mutate.py: 4 caught (height extra hours, ledger gate, demo gate, proposed margin on cost), 1 survived (postsAlong minimum 2 -> 1; no test covers a side shorter than the spacing).
evidence.craft: Read calc.mjs (471 lines), index.html wiring (lines 320-630), usage.mjs, test files. Pure engine, every input validated, flag() rejects unknown words instead of Boolean('no') = true. Minor: money formatter duplicated in calc.mjs:441 and index.html:356; footing count silently follows post count; attachment validation repeated in four helpers.
evidence.claims: Comparison-page table backed by presets and recomputed. 'Nothing uploaded' backed by usage.mjs storing only event counts. Disclaimer present on index.html:311 and every page. Buildxact page invents no prices and carries a non-affiliation note. served-copy.mjs: no placeholder origins. README event list omits proposal_printed (index.html:794) - stale, low.
evidence.fitness: Walked the 12x16 attached louvered job: preset, edit costs, proposed price, copy summary, print proposal all work in code. A crew could send a price. But the takeoff has no overhang/tails on beams (beamLf = width x rows exactly) and no beam or rafter size, so the stick list a crew would order from is not produced; footings default to one per post with no size/depth.
evidence.domain: Compared with common practice (e.g. AWC DCA 6 / IRC R507 tables for beam spans by member size, standard pergola framing with 12-24 in tails): post spacing here is a nominal divisor, not a maximum span, so bays reach up to 2x the entered spacing; beam length omits overhangs; no wind uplift / footing sizing (stated as a limit). Margin-on-price and loaded-wage method is sound.

checks.what: 10x10 freestanding open preset cost and price
checks.method: hand arithmetic + independent Python re-implementation from README method

checks.what: 12x16 attached slats preset cost, price, margin at $45/sf
bay never exceeds the entered post spacing
checks.method: max-span rule ceil(L/s)+1 as in span-table practice

checks.what: usage skips under DNT / GPC as README says

checks.method: read suggestedBeamLf vs standard pergola framing

mutations.change: ledgerHours gated on attached -> always hoursLedger
demoMaterial gated on demoExisting -> always demoFee

defects.what: postsAlong uses floor(L/spacing)+1, so the entered 'post spacing' is not a maximum: a 15-ft side at 8-ft spacing gets 2 posts (a 15-ft clear beam span), a 20-ft side 3 posts at 10-ft bays. Post, footing, knee-brace and labor counts are under-suggested on any side that is not a multiple of the spacing, with no warning that the bay exceeds the spacing typed.
No test covers a side shorter than the post spacing; mutating the minimum-two-posts guard to one survives the whole suite.

Beam lineal feet is width x rows with no overhang tails, and no beam/rafter member size is suggested; a pergola beam normally runs 1-2 ft past each post, so beam material and the stick list are short.
README 'Events counted' omits proposal_printed, which index.html records.
Money formatter duplicated between calc.mjs and index.html.

verdict: Arithmetic is right: an independent re-implementation reproduces all four published preset rows to the cent, margin is taken on price, inputs are validated, 131 tests pass and 4 of 5 seeded mutants are caught. It meets the bar on correctness, claims and verification, but a pergola estimator would flag the takeoff: 'post spacing' is a divisor not a maximum (a 15-ft side gets one 15-ft bay at 8-ft spacing) and beams carry no overhang, so fitness and domain sit at 2.
